svg.title: Setting up Liner in four steps
svg.desc: 1: Liner's screen shows two QR codes. 2: scanning the first joins the phone to the Liner-Setup network. 3: the setup page opens by itself; pick your Wi-Fi and enter the password. 4: Liner joins your Wi-Fi and shows now playing; the dashboard is at liner.local.
svg.text: Setup in four steps, no app, no cables
Fresh Liners and Liners that lost their Wi-Fi start here. Everything after the first USB flash happens from your phone.
